policy: ESSENTIAL runs on PRs and merge groups plus changed-area cases. GATED-FULL preserves the prior Go/unit/browser gate. NIGHTLY includes never-gated browser cases. Runtime reconciliation warns, defaults new cases to NIGHTLY and drops stale entries. Known-flaky cases and deletion candidates cannot be ESSENTIAL; AEON-679 rule B removes reviewed low-value categories; protected candidates stay available.
source: AEON-679 zb-web essential allowlist (60 browser, 155 unit)
taggingNote: Retained candidates and mixed groups were reviewed under AEON-679 rule B; protected assertions stay in their existing tiers. Deletion counts and archive evidence are in the coordinator deleted.md report.
